part: final-c days 10-15 (Niseko hotel, Annupuri, Rhythm, Rusutsu drift, Sapporo, Asahiyama, car drop), flights home, bookFirst

issues.problem: The 30-min Introduction course (¥31,000) runs only at 15:00; at 10:00 the only self-drive option is the 1 h 15 Driving course at ¥61,000.
issues.fix: Ski Rusutsu in the morning, 13:00 ride-along, 15:00 Introduction course, leave about 15:40 and drive straight to the hotel (dusk at about 16:40); do the laundry at the hotel. Or keep 10:00 and book the ¥61,000 Driving course.

issues.problem: The Subaru ride-along is ¥17,000 per person (for groups of 1-2), not ¥17,000 for 2, so both riding costs ¥34,000.
issues.fix: Budget ¥17,000 each; cheaper: Aoki rides in the rear seat during Pegasis's Introduction course for ¥10,000 (max 2 per car) instead of a separate ride-along.

issues.problem: The site only says a driver's licence must be shown (not for ride-along); it says nothing about foreign licences, IDP or a minimum of years, so the 1-year licence + IDP is not confirmed.
issues.fix: Keep the bookFirst email to activity@rusutsu.co.jp (tel 0136-46-3332). Note that a cancellation fee of 10% applies from the moment of booking, 50% from the day before.

issues.problem: Rusutsu has no afternoon ticket in 2026-27; the cheapest options are the 5-hour ticket ¥14,500 (¥11,600 online) or point tickets at ¥800 per point, which is costly for about 2 h of skiing.
issues.fix: Budget ¥11,600 online per person for a 5-hour ticket (use it in the morning if the drift moves to 13:00/15:00), or buy a few ¥800 points, or skip Rusutsu skiing.

issues.problem: The plan says the hotel has no coin laundry, but Niseko Northern Resort lists a coin laundry (washer ¥400 with detergent), so the Kutchan detour is not needed.
issues.fix: Do laundry night 3 at the hotel and drive Rusutsu → hotel directly (about 55 min).

issues.problem: Rhythm returns are due by 10:00 on the day after the rental period ends; the plan arrives at 10:20.
issues.fix: Leave the hotel at 09:30 and return the gear by 10:00 (3-day rental Jan 27-29; free pick-up from 13:00 on Jan 26 for pre-booked customers, so no 4th day is needed).

issues.problem: The official shop list gives GARAKU Sapporo main shop at Minami 3-jo Higashi 2-chome 6-1, Presant bldg B1F (east of the Sosei river), not the plan's point near Minami 2 Nishi 2; hours lunch 11:30-15:30 (LO 15:00), irregular closing days.
issues.fix: Update the map point and address; park in a coin park near Minami 3 Higashi 2 (the car is still with you).

issues.problem: Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi check-in is from 15:00 (check-out 10:00).
issues.fix: Drop bags at 14:50 and check in at 15:00, or return the car a little later.

issues.problem: Bus 41/47 fare is ¥670 (from Sep 2026) and only Asaca/DoCARD IC cards work, not Suica.
issues.fix: Pay cash or with a credit card at the ticket machine at stop 6 (buy 2 tickets each for the return trip). The winter timetable is not yet published; the summer one has bus 41 at 09:40 → 10:22.

issues.problem: Sapporo 08:00 → Asahikawa 09:25 and 15:00 → 16:25 exist, but the reserved-seat fare is ¥5,440 one way (¥10,880 return), a bit over the plan's ≈ ¥10,000.
issues.fix: Budget ¥10,880 each, or use an unreserved-seat discount ticket if available.

issues.problem: Could not open an official or listing page for Ramen Hachiya Gojo (10:30-19:50) or Daruma main shop (from 17:00) (Tabelog blocked, no official site found).
issues.fix: Check Google Maps for both the week before; Sunday lunch at Hachiya and 18:15 at Daruma are normally inside their hours.

issues.problem: Spring Airlines CTS→PVG nonstop does not show on Mon Feb 1 (it shows on Sun Jan 31 at ¥76,280 and Tue Feb 2 at ¥83,340); the cheapest Feb 1 option is Jetstar via Narita ¥51,250, landing 01:10 next day.
issues.fix: Remove the Feb 1 cheaper-flight note, or change it to 'Jetstar via Narita ¥51,250, arrives 01:10'.

issues.item: Pegasis to Lake Shikotsu ice festival
issues.problem: Buses are few: a direct Chuo Bus (空4) leaves the airport 11:31 → Shikotsu-ko 12:37, and the only fitting return is 15:40 → airport 16:39 (none between 12:45 and 15:40); the plan's via-Chitose-Station legs are slower.
issues.fix: Take the direct airport bus 11:31 (¥1,260) and the 15:40 bus back; check the winter timetable in January. Festival Jan 30-Feb 23, Tue = weekday ¥1,000, is confirmed.

issues.problem: Sapporo → New Chitose Airport costs ¥1,230, not ¥1,150; on Feb 2 a Rapid leaves 10:00 → 10:37.
issues.fix: Change the fare to ¥1,230; trains run every 12 min, so 09:50 is fine.

issues.item: bookFirst: Niseko Northern Resort price channel
issues.problem: The hotel's official site sells the same Deluxe twin with dinner + breakfast, 4 nights for 2, at ¥282,600 (90-day early bird, needs booking by about Oct 28) or ¥288,400 (60-day), cheaper than Jalan's ¥303,808; it also shows '1 room left'.
issues.fix: Book on the official site with the 90-day plan before Oct 28 (saves about ¥21,000 for 2). The hotel also has its own ski rental and lockers.

issues.problem: The Introduction course that the plan prices (¥31,000, 30 min) is only at 15:00, so a 10:00 booking does not exist for it.
issues.fix: Book the 15:00 Introduction course (and 13:00 ride-along if wanted); booking is prepaid with a 10% fee from booking, so book after the licence answer.

issues.problem: Toyota cancellation is free up to 7 days before pick-up, so waiting to December only risks the 4WD selling out.
issues.fix: Book both Toyota cars as soon as the booking system accepts the dates. One-way inside Hokkaido (CTS → Sapporo-ekimae) is allowed: https://rent.toyota.co.jp/static/service/oneway/

ok: Annupuri 2026-27 peak (Dec 24-Feb 28): 1 day ¥7,800, 5 h ¥6,700, 4-point ¥2,660, Dream No.1 Quad 1 point, hours 8:30-19:30 with night ski; Family 580 m max 11°, Paradise, Junior 960 m green runs, Dream Quad 433 m/4 min - https://annupuri.info/lift-tickets/ , https://annupuri.info/gelande/ (note: paid 'unauthorised lessons' are banned; a friend teaching quietly should be fine)
Niseko United all-mountain 1 day peak ¥13,500 - https://www.niseko.ne.jp/en/lift/
Niseko Northern Resort: Deluxe twin 30 m² exists, check-in 14:00/out 11:00, renovation ends Oct 31 2026, coin laundry - https://www.niseko-northern.com/room/mainbuilding.php

Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi, Kita 7 Nishi 4-2-2, coin laundry, bath, free breakfast - https://www.route-inn.co.jp/hotel_list/hokkaido/index_hotel_id_241/
